assertions.predicate: After merge and deployment, the registered app observer verifies that the production app release source commit contains this PR's merge commit. Release ancestry alone does not prove CI evidence retention.
assertions.expected_result: The observer records verified production app release ancestry. This assertion remains unproven until that observation runs.
assertions.input_class: read-only public app release identity and immutable app Git history

assertions.predicate: As an explicit pending observation step of the app runner, a reviewer reads a later CI push run on main containing this PR's merge commit, at run_attempt 1. The run retains four browser-results artifacts for 14 days, with per-shard native JUnit XML at out/browser-results/junit.xml. Artifact names bind the tested SHA, run ID, attempt 1 and native shard number. All four native shard jobs and the required test aggregate succeed. Each shard's critical-scenario assertion succeeds; the native XML collectively records exactly one passing, unskipped observation for each of the 23 required critical identities, including nested identities. Missing, duplicate, unsuccessful or rerun-only evidence fails this first-attempt observation. Read metadata and bounded native JUnit summaries only; if the budget cannot establish every condition, leave the observation pending. Artifacts are diagnostics, never inputs to aggregate success. Failed-only reruns use GitHub-retained successful job results without requiring those shards to emit new artifacts.
assertions.expected_result: A read-only reviewer records the main run URL, tested SHA, run ID, attempt 1, four shard job conclusions, required test aggregate conclusion, artifact IDs, retention metadata and the 23 passing critical identities from per-shard native JUnit XML. The app runner's automatic release check cannot establish this condition; its explicit observation step stays pending until that evidence is inspected. No existing PR run or synthetic report is claimed as main execution proof.
assertions.input_class: read-only GitHub CI job metadata and retained first-attempt per-shard native JUnit XML; explicit pending observation step
